text: Figgie connects interpretation and remedies: first identify the remedy the parties’ agreement contains, including trade usage, and only then decide whether that remedy remains enforceable. It demonstrates why a case needs to appear in more than one topic index.
sourceSummary: Uncontradicted evidence of industry practice supplied an exclusive repair, replacement, or refund remedy; the completed refund prevented that remedy from failing merely because earlier repair efforts had been unsuccessful.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
